The '''Bespin Government Center''' was a conical building on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], a floating [[City/Legends|city]] in the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. The Center was constructed by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and was guarded by [[Rebel trooper/Legends|rebel troopers]] along with Cloud City militants and [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|police forces]]. The city's [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron Administrator]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and his assistant [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]] were also in the vicinity when the Center was destroyed by order of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] by elements of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|Military]]. The Center was later replaced by an [[Imperial Palace (Monument)|Imperial Palace]], marking the end of fighting in the [[occupation of Bespin]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bespin Government Center appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' during the sixth mission and first bonus mission of the Darth Vader campaign titled "Cloud City Attack." The campaign is also included in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].<ref name="CC">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''</ref> The player must destroy it and build an Imperial Monument in its place to win the mission. The game's [[Prima Games|Prima]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]], released a week before the game, does not refer to it by its name, but rather as the "Rebel monument."<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>
